notes.title: 🔥 SOAI V0.11.0 🔥
notes.content:
Added

 Inventory and item display.
 Consumption of food-type items.
 Character needs, time update with current action and weather taken into account.
 Game engine updated to Unity 6.
 Damage management during the encounter with the monkeys: the narration takes into account the damage suffered and displays different texts.

Improved

 Collection quest now correctly takes into account items owned by the player.
 Quest sound.
 Fmod plugin and SplashScreen Sprite.

Fixed

 A few situations with monkeys have been improved in the layout.

Missing

 Credits

Issues

 Excessive game weight due to third-party plugin imports.
 Navigation causes agent to overrun destination.

notes.content:

 New map

 Character rendering

Fixed

 Credits

Issues

 Tooltip not closing if mouse exiting fast.
